name: Medical Necessity Not Established
description: Insurer determined the submitted documentation does not establish that the procedure was medically necessary.

name: Missing Prior Authorization
description: Procedure was performed without the insurer's required prior authorization on file.

name: Experimental/Investigational Procedure
description: Insurer classifies the procedure as experimental or investigational and outside covered benefits.

name: Insufficient Clinical Documentation
description: Submitted documentation was incomplete or did not meet the insurer's documentation requirements.

name: Duplicate Claim Submission
description: Insurer's system flagged the claim as a duplicate of a previously submitted claim.
